sonnet.problem: The true/false card asks about Psalm 8:5 ('a little lower than the angels') with no story card before it and no context from earlier cards. A baker who hasn't seen the verse can only answer by luck. Verse 5 is told on the story card after the question, so the setup comes too late.
sonnet.rule: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.
